spend_programs.description: Field Rep - Merchandising (58 people). Gas/parking/rideshare/grocery-for-supplies/meals. Grocery is for display materials (tape/cleaner) not food - see incident log Q3-25. Monthly cap $900, per-transaction cap $150. Permitted categories are translated from the merchant category codes in the matrix; see the audit log for every imprecise mapping.

Field Rep - Installation (41 people). Hardware and home-supply access is the differentiator vs merchandising. Auto parts for van consumables. Monthly cap $1400, per-transaction cap $300. Permitted categories are translated from the merchant category codes in the matrix; see the audit log for every imprecise mapping.

Store Auditor (17 people). Auditors buy almost nothing. Travel-adjacent only. Monthly cap $600, per-transaction cap $100. Permitted categories are translated from the merchant category codes in the matrix; see the audit log for every imprecise mapping.

Trainer (9 people). Trainers fly between districts. Airline range 3000-3299 per amex reporting. Monthly cap $2200, per-transaction cap $600. Permitted categories are translated from the merchant category codes in the matrix; see the audit log for every imprecise mapping.

District Manager (6 people). DMs also buy office supplies for district storage units. Monthly cap $3500, per-transaction cap $1000. Permitted categories are translated from the merchant category codes in the matrix; see the audit log for every imprecise mapping.

Seasonal Rep (140 people). Oct 19 - Dec 24 2026. NO meals NO hotels for seasonal - per diem stays in payroll for them. Cards must hard-stop Dec 24. Monthly cap $400, per-transaction cap $75. Cards lock automatically on 24 December 2026. Permitted categories are translated from the merchant category codes in the matrix; see the audit log for every imprecise mapping.
